name: Player Ranks
description: Shows each connected player's external rating in Live Status. Sources: qlstats, Slipgate, Thunderdome elo-service, or the game server's own status data. Needs QLSM with ui_api 4 or newer.

global.label: Slipgate API key (default)
global.description: Used by instances that leave their own key blank. Optional -- without any key, Slipgate is still queried publicly, one request per player.

global.label: Thunderdome elo-service API key (default)
global.description: Used by instances that leave their own key blank. This source returns nothing without a key, on any instance.

instance.label: Rating source
instance.description: One of: qlstats, slipgate, elo_service, server_status. Blank = no column. Validated against the live source registry on save, not a fixed list here -- see the 'Ranks' tab for the actual picker.

instance.label: Base URL
instance.description: Ignored by 'From the game server's own status data'.

instance.label: API key / token override
instance.description: qlstats needs none. Slipgate: optional -- with a key, one bulk request covers the whole roster; without one, one public request per player. Thunderdome elo-service: required, nothing is returned without it. Leave blank to fall back to the installation-wide default set on the Addons page.

instance.label: Game type / pool override
instance.description: Leave blank to use the server's live game type. qlstats/Slipgate only rate a fixed set of game types (duel/ffa/ca/tdm/ctf/ft/ad and a few Slipgate-only ones) -- an unrated type just means no query, not an error. Thunderdome elo-service has no such list; set this to the exact pool name (e.g. ffa_auto) it was configured with.

instance_ranks.description: Pick a rating source for this instance and it appears as a column in Live Status. Left on 'None', no column is added. If server.cfg already carries qlx_balanceUrl or qlx_rankedServiceUrl, the first load here suggests matching values -- nothing is written until you hit Save.

options.label: From the game server's own status data

fields.label: Base URL
fields.description: qlstats default: http://qlstats.net. Slipgate default: https://slipgate.gg. Thunderdome elo-service: required, no default (e.g. http://your-host:5002).

fields.label: API key / token override
fields.description: qlstats: not needed. Slipgate: optional (bulk vs public per-player lookups). Thunderdome elo-service: required. Blank uses the installation-wide default from Settings.

fields.label: Game type / pool override
fields.description: Blank = use the server's live game type. Set this for Thunderdome elo-service pools like ffa_auto.

global_keys.description: Installation-wide default API keys. An instance's own 'Ranks' tab can override either one.
